alt: A hallway and staircase viewed from the entry in five material schemes: deep ink blue panelling with pale limestone, terracotta limewash with dark oak treads, white panelling with striped runner, olive green walls with sisal runner and walnut, and charcoal walls with pale ash flooring.
text:
the wall decides which world you step into.

one staircase. four material schemes. the shape stays—it's the panelling and stone that rebuild the whole room. deep ink blue. terracotta. white. olive.

hallways aren't meant to impress. they're where aesthetic becomes the touch of your hand, without thinking. where the decision was made long before you arrived.
